title: End 2 End Operations Quality Assurance
description:
Job Description:
You will ensure that the company’s operational processes (develop, fulfil, support and source) comply with the quality assurance requirements, standards and internal or third party certification/approvals as defined in the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality plan for hardware/software/services.
You will devise and validate the hardware/software/services' control and inspection plan and ensure its proper implementation (using traditional and new methods, e.g. virtual/augmented reality).
You will monitor the conformity & attestation status.
Where deviations occur, you will be involved in the handling of the non- conformance including analysis of the deviations, monitoring of the corrective and preventive actions, as well as contributing to the improvement of the quality standards.
As such, you will collect, analyze, visualize and interpret the relevant process and/or in service performance data using available means (manual and automatic) to identify early process variations and to take effective actions by means of root cause analysis to mitigate and resolve any quality issues by supporting a robust PPS method application.
You will provide the evidence of conformity to processes and requirements to Programme Quality Assurance to ensure the satisfaction of customer requirements.
In new product / process / service development you will ensure that operational processes' lessons learnt and risk analysis are done early, and that relevant preventive quality standards are used in order to mitigate the risks and that a rigorous Development Plan (multi- functional reviews, maturity gates, ...) is followed.
You will implement & operate Prevention Means (such as APQP, DFMEA) . In case of software development you will ensure software and data integrity, verify and validate/certify the software and data in compliance with the appropriate standard for its specific application, e.g. on-board software, ground test software for prototype, small series production, simulation models, decision making support systems.
If applicable (within Procurement Quality), you will carry out supplier development and surveillance, supporting the qualification of supplier manufacturing processes and setting applicable requirements to suppliers.
If authorized, you will support the company's certifications and interfaces with external quality authorities (ISO, IAQG, EASA, etc.,).
KEY DELIVERABLES: Control and Inspection Plan, Product/Service Conformity for a given domain, Non Conformance Analysis and Action Plan, Supplier and Development Assurance Plan, APQP Key Business Deliverables (when owner).
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: to demonstrate conformity of processes and requirements for a given domain to Programme Quality Assurance and External Authorities (when authorized), to drive non conformity management at domain level for Programme Quality Assurance.

BETSOL's team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources.
  
  
We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Testing SAM publisher implementations
  
  

* Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output.
* Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover.
* Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not.
* Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts.
* Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line).
* Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances.

Building and running test automation
  
  

* Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines.
* Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight.
* Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks.
* Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers.

Quality process and reporting
  
  

* Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current.
* Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT.
* Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment.
* Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early.

**Qualifications**
Required qualifications
  
  

* Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance.
* Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries.
* Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from.
* Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr.
